reviewSamples.author: Photo of Carmen Cendros
reviewSamples.text: We bought the tiles for our two bathrooms and front porch at this store. We received excellent service and great prices. Everyone here is very helpful and knowledgeable and were able to guide me to finding the best tiles and materials to match. Everything turned out as I had pictured in my head. This is my fog-to place to shop tiles.
